calibration.calibration_note: Fast heuristic calibration from self-retrieval margins over all provided images, using per-pattern averaged gallery descriptors.

limitations: This patched trainer supports multiple images per patternId by averaging gallery descriptors within each layout.
Evaluation still runs on the same input folder, so if that folder contains near-duplicate variants, reported performance can remain optimistic.
The uploaded JSON did not contain *_px_bl fields; code therefore used x_norm/y_norm fallback with explicit logging and documentation.
